title: adelocaryum coelestinum
intro: Adelocaryum coelestinum, commonly known as Chinese coleus, is a plant species native to China and other parts of Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Adelocaryum coelestinum include its anti-hypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative effects, which contribute to its use in treating cardiovascular and respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Adelocaryum coelestinum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
